text:
All tests pass.

**Root cause:** `FileSystemLoader.get_source`'s `uptodate()` closure called `os.path.getmtime(filename)` unconditionally. When a previously-loaded template file was deleted, `Environment._load_template` calls `template.is_up_to_date` (since `auto_reload` is on), which invoked `uptodate()` and raised an uncaught `FileNotFoundError` instead of letting the loader report `TemplateNotFound`.

**Fix:** In `src/jinja2/loaders.py`, made `uptodate()` catch `OSError` (raised when the file no longer exists) and return `False` in that case. This causes the cached template to be considered stale, so `_load_template` falls through to `self.loader.load(...)` → `get_source(...)`, which correctly raises `TemplateNotFound` (or lets `ChoiceLoader`/`select_template` fall back to other loaders/names) instead of letting the raw `FileNotFoundError` propagate.

All tests pass.

**Root cause:** `FileSystemLoader.get_source`'s `uptodate()` closure called `os.path.getmtime(filename)` unconditionally. When a previously-loaded template file was deleted, `Environment._load_template` calls `template.is_up_to_date` (since `auto_reload` is on), which invoked `uptodate()` and raised an uncaught `FileNotFoundError` instead of letting the loader report `TemplateNotFound`.

**Fix:** In `src/jinja2/loaders.py`, made `uptodate()` catch `OSError` (raised when the file no longer exists) and return `False` in that case. This causes the cached template to be considered stale, so `_load_template` falls through to `self.loader.load(...)` → `get_source(...)`, which correctly raises `TemplateNotFound` (or lets `ChoiceLoader`/`select_template` fall back to other loaders/names) instead of letting the raw `FileNotFoundError` propagate.
